title: TFMC map export extensions
description: Draft contract for SimpleFactions → TFMCWeb map payloads. Nation upload remains the primary nation.json object; optional top-level keys extend the upload or ship as sidecar map_meta.json.

map_id.description: Must match website mapId and SF mapRef (e.g. main, dev)

settlement_large_population_threshold.description: SF config: settlements with population greater than this export marker_size large (default 8)

global_wealth.description: Optional server-wide wealth aggregate for charts

forts.description: Step 43 ZOC export — not used in step 54; use installations[] for map markers

installations.description: Step 54: forts, ports, airports placed via /faction construct

center_x.description: Minecraft block X at founding (SF export)

center_z.description: Minecraft block Z at founding (SF export)

population.description: Members of guilds whose capital is in the settlement province (SF export)

marker_size.description: Icon tier from SF population vs settlement_large_population_threshold

map_x.description: Pixel X on shared map grid (PS-served from province centroid)

map_y.description: Pixel Y on shared map grid (PS-served from province centroid)

zoc_provinces.description: Fort province plus one-ring land neighbors owned by factions in the same top realm (step 43 ZOC)

center_x.description: Minecraft block X at construct (SF export)

center_z.description: Minecraft block Z at construct (SF export)

name.description: Display name set in-game (hex colour supported)

center_x.description: Minecraft block X at construct (SF export)

center_z.description: Minecraft block Z at construct (SF export)

map_x.description: Pixel X on shared map grid (PS-served from center_x, 1:1)

map_y.description: Pixel Y on shared map grid (PS-served from center_z, 1:1)

center_x.description: Minecraft block X at faction capital settlement (SF export)

center_z.description: Minecraft block Z at faction capital settlement (SF export)

map_x.description: Pixel X on shared map grid (PS-served from center_x or centroid)

map_y.description: Pixel Y on shared map grid (PS-served from center_z or centroid)

status.description: Computed at SF export from active leg indices

province_name.description: PS-enriched display name for hover tooltips

map_x.description: Pixel X on shared map grid (PS-served from province centroid or capital coords)

map_y.description: Pixel Y on shared map grid (PS-served from province centroid or capital coords)

display_name.description: Player-facing battle title (SF BattleNamingService, same as campaign GUI)

war_line_point.description: PS-computed waypoint for campaign line smoothing (step 66)

war_type.description: Campaign shape; goal may further specify de_jure_annex vs subjugate

goal.description: One goal per war; raid wars use pillage outcome instead

belligerents.description: All faction ids on either side (main, subjects, called allies)

objective_province_id.description: Single capture/recapture province for this war

target_title_id.description: De jure title id when applicable

campaign_provinces.description: Ordered campaign polyline province ids (attacker capital through objective)

cursor_index.description: Border index into campaign_provinces (first invasion battle)

push_target.description: Active campaign push direction (step 66 route highlight)

attacker_capital.description: Attacker leader faction capital coords for line endpoint refinement

defender_capital.description: Defender leader faction capital coords for line endpoint refinement

campaign_line_points.description: Optional PS-computed centroids per campaign_provinces entry for FE spline

initiative_attacker.description: Step 68 full export; omitted in step 66 route slice

initiative_defender.description: Step 68 full export; omitted in step 66 route slice

white_peace_proposed_by_attacker.description: Attacker auto-proposed white peace (cannot reach capitulation target with remaining initiative)

occupied_by_attacker.description: Step 68 full export: provinces tinted as attacker-occupied (bulge front)

occupied_by_defender.description: Step 68 full export: provinces tinted as defender-occupied

last_battle_occupied.description: Step 68 full export: provinces added by the most recent battle

frontline_provinces.description: Deprecated alias; prefer occupied_* lists. Optional edge highlight.

chronicle_snapshot.description: Payload of the chronicle upload mode. Shipped every 300s. Ledger series contain absolute stock values; clients calculate observed changes when needed. Flow fields are full-day ledger projections and are NOT the observed stock change.

server_day.description: Completed in-game day rollovers. Counts server uptime, not calendar days, so it drifts against captured_at across downtime.

day_progress_seconds.description: Seconds into the current in-game day (0-86399)

complete.description: True from a successful export. A faction's absence only means deletion when this is true.

events.description: Reserved; always empty today. The event stream is still unowned on the SF side.

chronicle_global.description: Server-wide aggregates. The three wealth figures are deliberately not pre-summed: faction_wealth excludes all personal player money, so total money supply is a website decision.

max_wealth_prestige.description: SF config cap shared across factions by wealth share

faction_wealth.description: Sum of faction wealth. Excludes personal pouches and banks.

liquid_wealth.description: Bank component only, across all factions

expansion_wealth.description: Capital sunk into guild branch upgrades

guild_income.description: Server-wide daily inflation delta (flow, not stock)

id.description: Derived from the faction name, not a UUID. Reusable after deletion.

founded_at.description: Epoch seconds. Pair with id as the identity key so a recycled name does not splice two unrelated nations into one series.

wealth_breakdown.description: Keyed by modifier type (Bank, Expansions, Nodes) and by guild id for non-base guild rollups. Wealth is liquid bank plus sunk capital, so a faction can be wealthy with an empty treasury.

prestige_breakdown.description: Members, Wealth, Provinces, Titles, Subjects, '<pct>% Bonus', plus admin entries. The Wealth component is a share of global wealth, so prestige falls when rivals get richer; charts need this or the dips look like bugs.

rank_up_at.description: Competitive threshold, recomputed as the ladder shifts. Draw threshold lines from this, not from ranks.yml minimums.

chronicle_guild.description: The only view of the merchant economy separate from state finances.
